name: Micora
long_description:
Micora is a next-generation robotic energy developer that compresses the timeline from initial design to power generation from years to weeks. Our vertically integrated platform combines purpose-built robotic hardware with proprietary modular energy systems, enabling critical power infrastructure to be designed, manufactured, and deployed at unprecedented speed.

Traditional energy projects are slow, costly, and built around processes that were never designed for today’s rapidly growing power demands. Micora is rebuilding energy development from the ground up; transforming what has historically been a bespoke, multi-year construction process into a repeatable and scalable manufacturing system.

As demand from data centers, advanced manufacturing, and electrification strains existing power infrastructure, the ability to deploy new generation quickly is becoming increasingly valuable. Micora is building the infrastructure platform needed to deliver power wherever and whenever it is needed.
one_liner: Solar farm in a box built anywhere in days
